allow: PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 60; Write-Output "Status: $\($r.StatusCode\), Length: $\($r.Content.Length\)"; if \($r.Content -match "data-chat-open|Open chat"\){ Write-Output "OK: chat widget present" } } catch { Write-Output "FAIL: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" })
